description: Prevent reproducible Qt multimedia null-pointer crash on victory thumb: omit redundant named CLOSE before exclusive PLAY. Track selection and rewards unchanged.

edits.new:
if jo9_bgm_needs_start=1 or $music_now!$jo9_bgm_paths[jo9_bgm_index]:
  ! JO9 MOD START BGM_NULL_AUDIO_CRASH_20261116
  ! PLAY only already stops prior tracks. CLOSE of an unloaded missing track creates a null native audio entry and crashes the following exclusive PLAY.
  ! JO9 MOD END BGM_NULL_AUDIO_CRASH_20261116
  $music_now=$jo9_bgm_paths[jo9_bgm_index]
